response.sql:
WITH site_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval AS status,
    AVG(1.0 * sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_rate,
    AVG(sc.scancount) AS avg_count
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(1.0 * gbsize / spanmin) AS avg_rate
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(sr.avg_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(sr.avg_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(sr.avg_rate - o.avg_rate) AS average_excess
FROM site_rates AS sr
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE sr.avg_rate > o.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: The all-status average is the scan-weighted average of gbsize/spanmin across matched scans with both values present; status averages are then compared equally when averaging the qualifying statuses.

alternatives.interpretation: If the all-status average should include every scan, even scans without a matched site, use this query.
